Name: New Game Plus
Author: spacechase0
Description:
Start your save with some free stuff, and debuffs (all configurable).

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
When creating a save, check the New Game Plus checkbox above the advanced options button. When you start, you'll get a Legacy Token. Right click with it to spend your points! Leftover points give you gold. (Amount of points and gold per point configurable).

Most options are self-explanatory, though the "Horse" option gives you a flute and a token for a free stable.

You also start with Pierre's stock list and Ginger Island unlocked (configurable).

Certain penalties apply as well (though you can configure these to not do anything):
[list]
[*] Profit margin is smaller.
[*] Relationship point gains are less.
[*] Experience needed for each level is increased.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Uninstall[/size][/b]
Note: Price Multiplier will stay in effect after uninstallation. And of course your items won't disappear.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
